cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Lend Me the Edge
cards.instruction: Get someone to provide the one advantage you need without making the eventual success feel borrowed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've wrapped my fingers in tape like yours. Lend me your racket; I'd like a fair shot at winning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are taped because they're sprained. You need your fingers loose to hold a racket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, saving the grip for the match. I'll take the tape off; can I have your racket now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll lend it if you tell the club you won with my equipment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll thank you for the loan before we start. Afterward, let me talk about how I played.

reason: Replace the disconnected confidence prefaces with a specific copied act whose correction changes A's pursuit. Keep the exact Drive motive in the same exchange and give B a practical stake.
